notes:
Lead: PM (Ava Martin) building in-app onboarding copilot (guided flows). Primary ask: low and consistent latency for interactive chat + tool-calling (search, user profile fetch).

POC details:
- Using hosted API streaming for first-party onboarding flows embedded in product.
- Target p50 generation latency < 120ms for initial tokens, p95 < 400ms. Streaming start-time critical.
- Throughput: bursts tied to product tours (~50 concurrent sessions at peak per region), scaling expected.
- Token cost control: strict per-session caps (macro: 600 tokens/session), per-user monthly ceilings. Must avoid runaway token spend on exploratory users.
- Model preferences: prefer open/quantized candidates (Llama-style), open to Redwood-verified models if cost/latency tradeoffs are good.
- Fallback plan: route to smaller model variant for degraded capacity; require predictable quality fallbacks.

Commercial path:
- Start on Hosted API for fast rollout + telemetry. If POC throughput/cost targets hold, move to Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) within 6-9 months for predictable latency and cost.
- Asking for pricing scenario: hosted-monthly vs dedicated-6mo-commit (include burst capacity).

Security/compliance:
- Need SOC2 attestation, KMS integration for customer secrets, and audit logs retention 1 year. Data residency: US-only for onboarding telemetry.

- "Token spend is our single biggest unknown right now; we need strong cost caps + tooling to enforce them." - Head of Ops
